capabilities: Upload pasted or dragged images to a GitHub repository and swap in hosted links
Batch-upload all local images embedded in the current note
Render private-repo images in Reading View and Live Preview via authenticated fetch
Delete images from GitHub and notes, with multi-select and cross-note usage warnings
Report orphaned repository images that no note or canvas references
extras: Token encryption with AES-GCM and a master password is optional but recommended; SECURITY.md covers the vulnerability-reporting process. Legacy pre-v2 links need a classic token with access to all repositories.
motivation: The author was burned by an Imgur-style public uploader: uploaded images were publicly visible and he had no guarantee the service would keep running, so he wanted images in storage he controls.
problem: Pasted images bloat an Obsidian vault, and third-party image hosts make images public or may shut down, leaving notes with dead links.

relations.evidence: It uploads your pasted images to your own GitHub repository — which can be private
for public repos, serve images via the fast jsDelivr CDN

summary: Uploads pasted or existing images to your own GitHub repository and replaces local files with hosted links, rendering private-repo images via authenticated fetch.
